fixed_cycle.terminal_semantics_boundary: EMPTY_CNF_SAT and EMPTY_CLAUSE_UNSAT are direct semantic terminals. HORN and 2CNF are preserved only as recognized existing polynomial classes in R37B; R37B does not add or hide a new Horn/2SAT solver.

global_progress_theorem_contract.measure: M(F)=(C(F),L(F),V(F)) in lexicographic order, where C=active clauses, L=literal occurrences, V=active variables
global_progress_theorem_contract.R33_fact: Every accepted R33 rule application strictly decreases (C,L,V)_lex by the frozen R33 acceptance contract.
global_progress_theorem_contract.RUP_fact: Every R35B strengthening replaces one clause by a strict subclause; canonicalization either decreases C or preserves C and decreases L, hence strictly decreases (C,L,V)_lex.
global_progress_theorem_contract.domain_bound: For an input with m clauses and n variables, C<=m throughout because neither R33 nor RUP increases clause count; every canonical clause has width <=n, hence L<=m*n; V<=n.
global_progress_theorem_contract.successful_transformation_bound: At most (m+1)*(m*n+1)*(n+1)-1 strict measure decreases can occur. This is a deliberately loose polynomial bound.
global_progress_theorem_contract.restart_bound: Every restarted cycle must contain at least one RUP strict decrease after an R33 fixpoint; therefore restart count is bounded by the same polynomial state-measure domain.
global_progress_theorem_contract.per_operator_cost_requirement: Use only the existing polynomial scans/UP/GF2 procedures and expose their ledgers. The global termination theorem does not by itself prove a useful low-degree runtime bound and does not prove decision completeness.

frozen_checks.global_measure_monotonicity: Record every stage boundary and require strict lexicographic descent whenever formula bytes change.
frozen_checks.no_cycle_without_progress: If a complete R33->R34->RUP cycle makes no formula change, terminate STALLED_PORTFOLIO_FIXPOINT immediately.

captain_obvious_law: IF CERTIFIED OPERATORS REACTIVATE EACH OTHER, ITERATE THE FIXED PORTFOLIO UNDER ONE PROVABLY DESCENDING GLOBAL MEASURE BEFORE INVENTING ANOTHER OPERATOR.

interpretation_firewall.what_polynomial_termination_would_close: A bounded-termination obligation for this exact restart controller only.
interpretation_firewall.what_it_would_not_close: Universal decision completeness: the cycle may terminate at STALLED_PORTFOLIO_FIXPOINT.

next_gate_policy.if_exposed_world_reaches_declared_HORN_o: Freeze the cycle and separately integrate the standard polynomial terminal solver before any unseen test.
next_gate_policy.if_exposed_world_reaches_direct_or_affin: Freeze cycle byte-for-byte and preregister fresh unseen restart-cycle holdout.
next_gate_policy.if_fixpoint_stall: Seal exact fixpoint before selecting any new SAT-side mechanism.
